_doc: Heritable trait genes (M6, ROADMAP §3.2). Animals carry 0-2 alleles per trait (genotype); dominant traits express with 1+, recessive need 2. Each parent passes one allele with probability (alleles/2). R24: `wildChance` puts a gene into ordinary mail-order stock so it can be FOUND and bred up -- which is what makes the Mendel machinery worth having; `mutationOnly` traits stay out of the pool and arrive only as a conception mutation. Mechanical teeth: when a donor expressing the trait is extracted, part tokens in the listed slots are stamped with it; `statBonus` is applied by the physiology engine and `moveKeywords` is merged into those parts' moves, under the part's own keywords so a gene never overwrites what a part already did. Every trait pays for what it gives. Adding traits must never require engine edits.

traits.name: Dense Bones
traits.desc: Skeleton certified to municipal load-bearing standards. Head and hide parts extract with +3 Armor, and carry the weight.

traits.name: Hollow Bones
traits.desc: Aeronautically sound, structurally optimistic. Limbs come out quick and brittle.

traits.name: Deep Lungs
traits.desc: Organ bays that treat a fight as a long walk. More in the tank, slower to refill.

traits.name: Thick Hide
traits.desc: Upholstery, essentially. Hides plate up and the creature stops hurrying.

traits.name: Hyperthyroid
traits.desc: Everything at once, all the time. Heads and organs hit harder on a shorter fuse.

traits.name: Second Wind
traits.desc: An organ that quietly refuses to be tired. Costs a little muscle to run.

traits.name: Glass Jaw
traits.desc: Spectacular offence, structurally regrettable. Recessive, and the lab keeps breeding it by accident.

traits.name: Venom Gland
traits.desc: A duct where no duct was ordered. Head parts envenom on contact.

traits.name: Barbed Skin
traits.desc: Touching it is a decision. Hide parts return a share of what they take.

traits.name: Keen Eye
traits.desc: Sees the dodge before it happens. Head parts stop being dodged.

traits.name: Clotting Factor
traits.desc: Knits itself back together between arguments. Organ parts carry +10 HP and a little less hurry.

traits.name: Pack Instinct
traits.desc: Cannot be told it is fighting alone. Organ parts lift the whole side.
